name: Octree Partitioning for Sphere Tracing
definition: Partitioning the domain into an octree allows imposition of local bounds on Lipschitz constants, yielding tighter signed distance bounds and culling of nodes that cannot intersect the surface.
summary: Octree partitioning for sphere tracing accelerates implicit surface rendering by using static local Lipschitz bounds to cull nodes, distinguishing it from segment tracing's dynamic bounds.
